notes: Check back for registration dates. A research paper is part of taking part.
name: World Food Prize Youth Institute at Purdue
what_you_do: Write a research paper on a world hunger problem in one country. Then present it at Purdue to faculty, staff and industry experts. You also meet people in farming and food security.
who_can_apply: Indiana high school students with an adult mentor. Grades and ages are not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Listed as Spring 2027. The page says registration dates for 2027 will be shared when available.
how_to_apply: Not posted yet. Contact Anna Egan (williaak@purdue.edu) for questions.
